en: A vintage street scene showing people walking and a horse-drawn carriage on a cobblestone street lined with tall, historic buildings. The architecture features steep, gabled rooftops typical of northern European cities. There are shop signs, awnings, and people dressed in early 20th-century clothing. Distinctive handwritten text is visible at the top, and the word 'RUBIN' appears on a storefront. The lower right corner has a signature or printed word 'PARIKAS.'
